tasks.short: Produce overlay maps of boundaries, water and features.

steps.what: Pull base maps that show information boundaries.
Draft an overlay to show various scales.

loop.input: the named layers and the scale the request asked for
loop.output: an overlay that uses only those layers at that scale
loop.check: a layer that was not named is discarded
loop.stop: one draft; a missing layer is left off
loop.why_not_simpler: whether water and boundaries sit correctly is the check

steps.what: Check water locations and topographic features.
Produce or update the overlay maps.

tasks.design: Base maps and named layers are pulled on {DATA_PLATFORM}. An overlay may be drafted only at the requested scale, to show those layers. The technician checks water locations, information boundaries and topographic features. {OPS_SYSTEM} produces or updates the map only after that check.
tasks.previous_blocker: Overlays were drawn by copying one map onto another, and the scale was sometimes wrong.
tasks.enabler_now: Named layers at a stated scale can be stacked. Whether the water sits correctly cannot.
tasks.still_hard: A boundary that has moved, or a scale the base map does not support, stays a check.
tasks.human_edge: The technician sees a water line that the layers have shifted.
tasks.altitude: Stacking named layers takes less copying. Checking water, boundaries and features stays.

evidence.claim: Stacking named layers at a stated scale is a draft. Checking where water and boundaries sit is not.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the technician produces the overlay and checks it. Collecting the base data is a different task.
Structured input: base map id, layer name, scale. Producer is the request for the names and the store for the layers. A layer that was not named is not drawn.
The check is remaining time. The draft does not move a boundary to make the overlay look complete.
unknowns: Are overlay requests stated as layer names and a scale?
research_questions: How often is an overlay reissued because the scale was wrong?

already_counted.description: Checking the overlay is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Retire draft overlays when the base map changes.

approvals.approved_version: overlay the technician accepted at that scale

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the request does not name layers and a scale, nothing is drafted and the technician still reads it. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Trace contours to generate maps of property locations.

steps.what: Trace contours and topographic details by hand.
Generate maps that denote specific property locations.
Check geographic attributes against the tracing.

tasks.design: Tracing contours and topographic details stays by hand. {OPS_SYSTEM} generates a sheet from that tracing so the map can denote the property locations. The technician checks geographic attributes and scaled distances against the tracing. The sheet does not invent a line.
tasks.previous_blocker: Tracings were inked, and the copy onto the map sheet was a second drawing.
tasks.enabler_now: A finished tracing can be copied. Choosing the line cannot.
tasks.still_hard: A faint contour, or an attribute the tracing does not show, stays the trace and the check.
tasks.human_edge: The technician feels where the contour should break.
tasks.altitude: Copying a finished tracing takes less redrawing. Tracing and checking the attributes stay.

reach.learn: Which attribute did not match the tracing

evidence.claim: Copying a finished tracing onto a sheet is a transfer. Tracing the contour is not.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the technician traces and checks. Publishing the map is a different task.
Structured input: tracing id, property id, attribute name. Producer is the technician for the tracing. A line with no tracing id is not generated.
Tracing time stays. The sheet does not add a contour.
research_questions: How often is a contour redrawn because the copy drifted?

already_counted.description: Tracing the contours is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Retire generated sheets when the tracing is replaced.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the tracing is only on film, the generate step does nothing and the trace stays. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Interpret aerial photographs for significant features.

steps.what: Analyze aerial photographs by viewing the area.
Detect candidate shapes, not a topographical label.

loop.input: the photograph id and the shapes visible in that frame
loop.output: candidate locations with no significance label
loop.check: a candidate that carries a military, industrial or resource label is discarded
loop.stop: one pass; the technician interprets what is significant
loop.why_not_simpler: significance is the interpretation, and the draft must not decide a tax or a classification

steps.what: Interpret significant military, industrial or resource data.
Record the interpretation, not the candidate.

tasks.design: The technician analyzes the aerial photographs by viewing them. A pass may detect candidate shapes and must not label them as military, industrial, resource or topographical significance. The technician interprets what is significant. {DOCS} records that interpretation. A candidate is not a finding, and it does not set a tax.
tasks.previous_blocker: Photographs were interpreted at a desk, and a later reader could not see what had been called significant.
tasks.enabler_now: A visible shape can be proposed. Calling it significant cannot.
tasks.still_hard: A frame that is unclear, or a use that would feed a tax or a security decision, stays the technician's interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: The technician has read this landscape and knows what a shape is likely to be.
tasks.altitude: Proposing shapes takes less first scanning. Viewing and interpreting significance stay. The record is the interpretation.

reach.task: Read the interpretation, not the candidate list

evidence.claim: Proposing a visible shape is a draft. The source pack names change detection that staff review one signal at a time. Calling the shape significant is the review, not a measured case here.

The source pack names a rule that a change-detection result must not set a property tax by itself, and that a use in critical infrastructure needs a closer look. This record is the technician's interpretation. Other countries differ.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the technician views and interprets. A tax assessment or a security classification is a different task and is not fed by the candidate list.

Structured input: photograph id, candidate location, and the interpretation text. Producer is the photograph for the frame and the technician for the interpretation. A candidate with a significance label is discarded.
Interpretation time stays. The record does not copy the candidate into a finding.
unknowns: Who may see an interpretation that mentions a sensitive site?
research_questions: How often is a photograph reread because the first note did not say why it was significant?

already_counted.description: Interpreting the photographs is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Retire candidate lists after the interpretation is recorded.

approvals.approved_version: interpretation the technician made for that photograph

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the photographs are prints only, there is no candidate pass and the technician still views and interprets. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Choose scales, colors and sizes for plotter copies.

steps.what: Determine scales, sizes and colors for copies.
Send computerized maps to the plotters.
Check the hard copy against the map.

tasks.design: The technician determines scales, line sizes and colors for the hard copies. {OPS_SYSTEM} sends the computerized maps to the plotters only with those settings. The technician checks the hard copy. A default scale is not sent.
tasks.previous_blocker: Plot settings were chosen at the machine, and a wrong scale was seen only on the paper.
tasks.enabler_now: Sending a file to a plotter is a job. Choosing the scale and the colors is not.
tasks.still_hard: A map that will not read at the requested scale, or a plotter that is down, stays a decision and a check.
tasks.human_edge: The technician knows which line weight the hard copy needs.
tasks.altitude: Sending the chosen settings takes less standing at the plotter. Determining them and checking the copy stay.

evidence.claim: Sending a file to a plotter with stated settings is a job. Choosing the scale is not.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the technician chooses settings and checks the copy. Designing the map is a different task.
Structured input: map id, scale, line size, color. Producer is the technician. A send with no scale is refused.
The choice and the check stay. The plotter does not pick a scale.
unknowns: Which plotters accept a scale and a line size?
research_questions: How often is a hard copy reprinted because the scale was wrong?

already_counted.description: Choosing the settings is already the remaining time on that step.

approvals.approved_version: plot settings the technician determined for that map

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the plotter cannot take a file, the technician still chooses the settings and plots by hand. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Overlays are drafted from named layers and checked before they are produced. Tracing stays by hand. Aerial interpretation, including anything sensitive, is the technician's, and a candidate shape is not a finding. Plotter settings are chosen, then the hard copy is checked.
reach: The party chief issues the published overlay, not the draft.
An interpretation is readable without the candidate list.
skills_to_grow: Leave a layer off when it was not named.
Do not let a shape set a tax or a classification.
role.ambitious_version: A water line that has shifted is caught before the overlay is produced, and a photograph with no clear reading stays uninterpreted.
